capture: fixtures/recorded/instruction.ja.txt is the e-mid instruction copied byte for byte from the generic-bench task (its SHA-256 equals the instruction_sha256 the bench records). fixtures/recorded/runs.jsonl is a hand-reduced excerpt of the nine CommandAgent e-mid r1 runs of the L-142 generic comparison pilot (binary built from a520c084). Each line names its run_dir (bench root replaced by <bench>), the events.jsonl path inside it, the SHA-256 of that events file, the step_obligation_scope line (prompt_extracted_paths, explicit_required_paths), the final loop_stop line (reason, non_scaffold_missing_paths), the tool_call_raw lines that asked to Write a quoted example, and the host grader verdict. Arm ids are bench labels; no provider, model, or credential is recorded.
derived_fixture: fixtures/synthetic/cases.json is synthetic: hand-authored extraction cases and scripted runs. Each case names the test that runs it in src/minimal_loop/loop_run/requested_artifacts/tests.rs or tests/requested_artifact_code_expressions.rs.
